title: Corona Vaccine Online Registration 2021
organization: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / CoWIN
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.cowin.gov.in or Aarogya Setu / UMANG
2. Register with mobile number
3. Add beneficiaries with photo ID
4. Book slot at nearby centre
5. Download certificate after vaccination
shortDescription: Corona Vaccine Online Registration 2021 – CoWIN portal for COVID-19 vaccination booking and certificates.
content:
CoWIN is the national platform for COVID-19 vaccination registration, slot booking and digital certificates.

Citizens registered with mobile OTP, booked vaccine slots, and downloaded certificates. Portal: cowin.gov.in.
